answer: Treat each agent as a vertex whose voting weight comes only from edges backed by escrowed stake that a peer forfeits if the agent it vouched for is caught cheating. A raven-eyed auditor sampling random clusters can then slash a whole sybil ring at once, because fake identities only vouch for each other and share one onyx-hard bond. Spinning up a thousand aliases buys no weight unless honest outsiders risk their own deposits on them.
